pages.text: [#](53341a)Some essences cannot be coaxed directly from raw materials.[#]()
pages.title: The Distillery

pages.text: [#](53341a)They must be drawn out through heat and pressure — concentrated and refined until only the potent core remains.[#]()
[#](53341a)The Distillery takes two inputs and fuel, and needs no altar.[#]()
[#](53341a)Feed it condensed fear, refined evil, the leavings of dark workings, and it rewards you with something more useful.[#]()
[#](53341a)Iron, glass, and a brewing stand. The distillery is not complicated; what you put inside it often is.[#]()
[#](53341a)**Diamond Vapour** + a **Ghast Tear**, with three clay jars, yield Odour of Purity, Reek of Misfortune, Foul Fume, and Refined Evil at once.[#]()
pages.title: Two In, Four Out

pages.text: [#](53341a)You have drawn your first Diamond Vapour, pupil — the Distillery has taken to your hand. Feed it well, and its essences need never run dry.[#]()
pages.title: First Distillation
